name: Genny Altwer
title: Candidate for San José City Council, District 9 (2026)
background: Altwer earned a criminal justice degree from San José State and served 13 years as a sworn officer with the San Mateo Police Department; endorsers describe her as a former sexual-assault detective and hostage negotiator. She is now a licensed marriage and family therapist and small-business owner. This is her first run for office. (San José Spotlight)

She placed first in the June 2, 2026 primary with 35.5%, campaigning on crime, housing costs, and homelessness. She is endorsed by Mayor Matt Mahan, Rep. Sam Liccardo, Vice Mayor Pam Foley, several business groups, the police union, and Planned Parenthood, and had raised $183,216 including a $15,000 personal loan. In July her campaign removed an endorsement from former rival Mike Hennessy after he said he had not given one. (San José Spotlight; San José Inside)
